activation_policy.selection: Select capabilities per task from the project's verified context; do not load the whole catalog.
activation_policy.default_skill_budget: One primary skill and zero or one complementary skill; three total is an exceptional ceiling, not a target.
activation_policy.deactivation: A capability not selected for the current task is simply not loaded or invoked. This registry does not claim automatic installation or runtime enable/disable of system tools.
activation_policy.gap_discovery: Use the existing GAP_CLOSURE_PROTOCOL.md before adding a capability or external dependency.
activation_policy.resource_gate: Check platform compatibility, RAM, storage, CPU/GPU, network use, licensing, maintenance, permissions, and cost before adoption.
activation_policy.approval_gate: Research and read-only inspection are routine. System-wide installation, paid services, external publication, permission changes, secret changes, merge, deploy, and destructive operations require explicit authorization.

capability_families.purpose: Resolve project identity, scope, context, dependencies, risk, and the minimum useful capability set.
Understand source repositories, architecture, dependencies, execution paths, and make minimal verified changes.
Analyze authorized shipped artifacts and develop the independent Guerra Infinita successor.
Product research, affiliate content, distribution, public integrations, and conversion analysis.
Requirements, operational workflows, records, inventory, orders, payments, and reporting.
Handle HR workflows and personal data with purpose limitation, access control, retention, and legal review.
Authentication, authorization, cryptography, databases, APIs, deployment planning, and incident-safe operations.
Create architecture maps, process diagrams, UI wireframes, and maintainable technical documentation.

external_tool_candidates.name: Excalidraw
external_tool_candidates.proposed_use: Architecture diagrams, process flows, dependency maps, and wireframes.
external_tool_candidates.adoption_gate: Evaluate hosted/browser-first use and export/import workflow before considering a local or embedded integration.
external_tool_candidates.resource_note: Prefer browser use first; no installation or runtime dependency is required for initial evaluation.
external_tool_candidates.license_note: Verify current upstream LICENSE and dependency terms at adoption time.

external_tool_candidates.name: GitReverse
external_tool_candidates.proposed_use: Generate an initial repository-understanding prompt from public repository metadata, shallow root structure, and README; use only as a triage aid.
external_tool_candidates.limitations: Not binary reverse engineering, not a complete source-code audit, and not proof of runtime behavior. Generated prompts must be checked against actual source and tests.
external_tool_candidates.adoption_gate: Recheck repository identity, maintenance, license, dependencies, data handling, and local resource requirements before use.

registry_notes: This is an initial portfolio and capability map, not proof that every listed skill is loaded or every project is currently active in a runtime.
Project-specific skills and tools must be chosen from actual task requirements; capability mappings are suggestions, not automatic execution commands.
Do not create a new skill when an existing skill plus a small routing or evaluation update is sufficient.
